dataset_name: Professional Dota 2 match time remaining at minute ten
target_name: remaining match duration after ten minutes
prompt:
Task: At the ten-minute mark of this professional Dota 2 match, estimate how many more seconds will elapse before the match ends.
Target: remaining match duration after ten minutes
Target unit: seconds
Input format: a JSON object. null means missing.
Field definitions and context: radiant_heroes and dire_heroes list the five heroes drafted by each side. radiant_earned_gold and dire_earned_gold give the total gold earned by each side through minute ten.
Input JSON: {"radiant_heroes":["Tiny","Wraith King","Dazzle","Skywrath Mage","Muerta"],"dire_heroes":["Shadow Fiend","Lion","Luna","Chaos Knight","Disruptor"],"radiant_earned_gold":15369,"dire_earned_gold":15214}
Return only one numeric prediction for the target.
